quickAnswer.title: WAEC grades in one minute
quickAnswer.body: A1, B2, B3, C4, C5, and C6 are credit grades; D7 and E8 are passes; F9 is a fail. Lower planning-point values are stronger, but the subjects and aggregate method that matter depend on the country, institution, programme, entry mode, and year.

referenceTable.title: WAEC A1-F9 grade table
referenceTable.intro: The interpretation labels explain the grade itself. A credit does not automatically satisfy a particular programme's subject requirements.

faqItems.question: What counts as a credit in WAEC?
faqItems.answer: A1, B2, B3, C4, C5, and C6 are credit grades. The subject still needs to match the programme requirement you are checking.

faqItems.question: Is D7 a pass or a credit?
faqItems.answer: D7 is a pass, not a credit. E8 is also a pass rather than a credit, while F9 is a fail.

faqItems.question: How do I calculate a WAEC aggregate?
faqItems.answer: First identify the published rule for the country, institution, and programme. Convert only the selected grades to points and add them. There is no single best-six formula that decides every application.

faqItems.question: When will 2026 WAEC results be released?
faqItems.answer: This guide does not predict a release date. Check the official WAEC office for your examination and country, because schedules and notices can change.
